chunks: And it is narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh (peace be upon him) who said:
There is a reward for every act except for the tear shed for us.

key_terms.ثَوَابٌ: Reward or recompense for good deeds
key_terms.فِينَا: For us (referring to the Ahl al-Bayt/Imams)

ai.seo_question: What is the unique reward for shedding tears for the Ahl al-Bayt according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ṣādiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes the emotional devotion of weeping for the Ahl al-Bayt as a unique act of worship with singular reward, elevating it beyond standard deeds. This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* underscores the centrality of *al-munāsaba* (thematic connection) and *al-ḥubb* (love) in Shia spirituality, where tears serve as a tangible manifestation of deep spiritual attachment to the Imams. It reflects the scholarly view that mourning is not merely ritualistic but a transformative act of *tawassul* (seeking nearness) to God through the Prophet's household.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. It is narrated that: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said, “
There is a (known) reward for every act except for shedding tears over us.”
